registrationFormText.thankYouText: Thank you for your interest in becoming a participating site of the Alzheimer’s Network for Treatment and Diagnostics (ALZ-NET).
registrationFormText.pleaseNoteText: Please note: Do not complete the form more than once for the same site location. If you have already submitted a registration for this site, please contact alznet@acr.org for assistance.
registrationFormText.instructionsText: Instructions: After reviewing the ALZ-NET protocol synopsis, please complete the feasibility and registration questionnaire below. All fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. Once submitted, you will receive a confirmation email and our team will review your submission.
